set -e
make -C /work/submit clean
make -C /work/submit CXX=g++ CXXFLAGS='-O2 -std=c++17'
(
  ulimit -v 524288
  /work/submit/planb64 build /work/planb-stress/fib /work/planb-stress/final-image
  /work/submit/planb64 lookup /work/planb-stress/final-image /work/planb-stress/trace batch 255 > /work/planb-stress/final-output
)
cmp /work/planb-stress/final-image /work/planb-stress/image
cmp /work/planb-stress/final-output /work/planb-stress/scalar.out
/work/submit/planb64 build /work/examples/fib.txt /work/release-example.idx
cmp /work/release-example.idx /work/examples/expected.idx
/work/submit/planb64 lookup /work/release-example.idx /work/examples/trace.txt scalar > /work/release-output
cmp /work/release-output /work/examples/expected.txt
find /work/submit -maxdepth 1 -printf '%y %f %s bytes\n' | sort
if find /work/submit -type l | grep -q .; then exit 1; fi
echo FINAL_VERIFICATION_OK
